blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The alleged coercion of two former staff members of Vice President Sara Duterte to sign affidavits making false claims against her, as related by her spokesperson, lawyer Paolo Panelo, lacked details and official documentation. In an interview with TV5, Rep. Terry Ridon, a House prosecutor, questioned both the initial account and a subsequent statement suggesting the matter had been resolved. He said reports of coercion deserved attention, but the statements lacked information needed to assess the allegations.
